instructions: Compare the changed clause with the linked clause. Does the changed clause contradict the linked clause? When target_non_goal is true, the linked clause lists items its spec excludes: answer yes only when you can name the listed item the changed clause adds or requires, even when the wording matches; if you cannot name one, answer no. Otherwise answer yes only when the changed behavior conflicts with the linked clause. Restating, extending, or merely relating to it is no.

labels.name: yes
labels.description: The changed clause conflicts with the linked clause: what it states is incompatible with what the linked clause states.

input.before: The base end is the commit whose spec bytes are compared, which is the selected base or, for a spec absent there, its first committed seed.
input.after: The base end is the selected base commit; a spec absent there is entirely new, as focus defines.
input.target: The baseline response retains the selected commit in base and identifies the actual HTML snapshot in htmlBase; a file absent from the selected base uses its stable first committed seed, or null when still uncommitted.

input.before: Only human clicks write spool events.
input.after: The agent automatically writes a move event.
input.target: Only a human click on Move comment here writes, using existing events.

labels.name: no
labels.description: No conflict: the changed clause restates, extends, belongs to another layer, is a sibling row of one table, names a Jev label word such as contradicts or oversteps, or is unrelated to the linked clause.

input.before: The server stores one judgment record for each question.
input.target: The records are the cache: each is keyed by a hash of its question inputs and set version.

input.before: The row links to the Reports page contract.
input.after: The row links to the Insights page contract.
input.target: The Insights page, formerly Reports, reads the same data.

input.after: 4 No token from rows 1 to 3, waiting_on spec review. One lane token at Spec review, owed to you.
input.target: 5 No token from rows 1 to 3, waiting_on QA review or merge. One lane token at QA and merge, owed to you.

input.after: As an operator, an existing single-bundle evidence service keeps working as before.
input.target: As an operator, I can run one annotateanything evidence service for many independent evidence bundles, each with its own stable path, exact bytes, and bundle identity.
